record.field: Start a quotation request for a product: picks up to 3 vendors from the purchase history (never vendors bought through an intermediary) and prepares one DRAFT request for quotation per vendor. NOTHING is sent: a person must approve in Odoo. Call it once per need. Use 'Find Product' first to get the product id, and ask the user for the quantity.
List the quotation requests (id, product, state, reply deadline). Use it when the user does not give the request id.
Read a quotation request: state, deadline, the vendors asked and the replies they wrote (text). Use it to read the vendors' answers before registering their quotes.

Register the quote a vendor wrote in its reply on its draft request for quotation. Only register numbers the vendor clearly wrote; if the reply is unclear or in another unit, ask the user instead. Returns the updated comparison.
Rank the registered quotes of a request (on time first, then cheapest) with alerts. The ranking is computed by Odoo: explain it, do not recalculate it.
Save your recommendation on the request so the buyer sees it. A person decides and confirms the purchase.
